principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator class inherits from AreaCalculator, but it calculates volumes instead of areas. This violates the Liskov Substitution Principle because the subclass (VolumeCalculator) is not consistent with the behaviour of the superclass (AreaCalculator).
principle_violations.suggestion: Create an abstract base class for calculations (e.g. Calculator), separate classes for area and volume calculations that implements the Calculator class, separate interfaces for 2D and 3D shapes. The 2D interface implements the area method, the 3D interface the volume method.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
